latest_findings: CFTC Letter 26-05 was requested by Coinbase Financial Markets and is a conditional staff no-action position, not a rule.
The letter distinguishes futures/cleared-swaps accounts from 30.7 accounts; the latter has an additional underlying-commodity-of-a-CFTC-DCM-futures path.
Bitnomial DCO lists XRP at a 40% haircut and $15M notional limit. Bitnomial announced XRP/RLUSD collateral before Coinbase's CFTC request, so the request did not cause the original support.
Payward completed the Bitnomial acquisition on May 1, 2026. Direct Coinbase/Bitnomial clearing, Coinbase FCM notice/reliance and actual XRP collateral balances remain unknown.

OI providers report materially different contract universes; TradRadar, Kodexius and Seandra values are not aggregated. ETF flows +3.39M XRP for Oct 23-30 exclude GXRP flow catch-up. Exchange wallet total 22.45B includes cold storage and is not tradable float.

PR #1475 now revalidates outcome source hashes against the registered source hash. Latest head 8268d158 passed 405 tests + 8 subtests and fail-closed gate. Semantic verification of submitted price values against immutable source bytes remains future work.
